title: Slovakian Toast
description: A simple Slovakian-inspired dish featuring toasted bread topped with aromatic ingredients.

ingredients.name: Slovakian Aromatic Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: available at most European grocery stores or online

instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle to medium heat.
Toast the bread slices until lightly browned on both sides.
Mix the Slovakian Aromatic Spice Blend, butter, and sour cream in a small bowl.
Spread the spice blend mixture evenly over the toasted bread slices.
Top with chopped fresh chives and a pinch of salt.
